verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed Airbyte publishes an llms.txt at docs.airbyte.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented product summary, so a user can point an agent straight at it. The API reference also serves pages as .md files, which agents can read directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering and its scope (e.g. a full-content llms-full.txt variant), independent community corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.airbyte.com/llms.txt # docs.airbyte.com llms.txt
